found_basis: Public PINDER benchmark supplies Python source, installation commands, input download interfaces, and executable pinder_eval scoring entry point. This does not establish successful reproduction of its external docking baseline.

outcome_definition.primary: Recovery of experimentally observed protein-protein binding poses using paired apo inputs; evaluate top-ranked prediction separately from best of a fixed candidate set.
outcome_definition.scientific_claim_limits: No inference of BBB transcytosis, binding affinity, or therapeutic relevance from docking accuracy.

size.reason: Selected 93-case input footprint and docking peak working set not measured. Whole-dataset size must not substitute for selected-workload size.

scoring_rules.search_coverage: Score maximum DockQ among fixed candidate count separately from rank-1; also retain iRMS and Fnat.
scoring_rules.candidate_count_basis: Fixed intake design using published FRODOCK README clustering example --nc 100, not a verified PINDER paper configuration.
scoring_rules.aggregate: Fraction of the fixed 93 paired-apo cases with acceptable poses, separately rank-1 and best-of-100.
scoring_rules.missing_predictions: Record failures explicitly. PINDER defaults assign iRMS=100, LRMS=100, Fnat=0, DockQ=0 and CAPRI=Incorrect to missing predictions; do not silently drop cases.
scoring_rules.important_difference: PINDER leaderboard CAPRI classes in inspected implementation use Fnat/iRMS/LRMS rules. Brief requires a DockQ >=0.23 criterion; compute it explicitly from per-model DockQ rather than equating it with CAPRI_rank.

repeatability_rules.case_selection: Fixed set: all PINDER-S cases with both apo_R and apo_L available in the pinned index; published count 93. Freeze index checksum and sorted IDs before execution.
repeatability_rules.reason: Brief requests independent random seeds but gives no values or repeat count. No seed invented. FroDock deterministic search should not be called independent stochastic replication.
repeatability_rules.input_pin_reason: Release label is known, but individual content hashes and fixed case manifest not captured.

separate_challenge.mode: Redocking from separated bound components; not independently determined unbound structures.

blockers: FroDock source archive required by the published baseline Dockerfile was not obtained; its linked download page returned HTTP 404. Public chaconlab/FRODOCK repository tree inspected contains documentation and assets, not executable source.

Published PINDER method runner uses pandas.from_csv, and FroDock adapter contains apparent path concatenation and wildcard shutil.copy defects. These are source-inspection findings, not reproduction results.
No immutable pin or hash for the external FroDock software archive was established.
All 93 paired-apo input files and their mappings were not individually verified. Published README warns that archives omit some manifest files.
Representative runtime, peak CPU/GPU memory, fixed repeat count, and independent seed values are unavailable; no build or workload was run.

gate.reason: All required inputs not established accessible; docking-baseline acquisition and reproducibility incomplete. Unknown licence and absent reproduction tolerance are not rejection reasons.
